topic: The Mathematical Trinity: Powers, Roots, and Logarithms

sections.title: The Bridge: Prerequisite Recap
lecture_lines: Imagine a seed growing into a tree.
The base is our starting seed.
The exponent is our growth time.
The result is the final height.
Two raised to three equals eight. [Asset: growth_tree_animation]
animations: Show title 'The Bridge: Prerequisite Recap' in #FFCC00.
Fade out title, show seed mobject [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/seed.svg] in #00FF00.
Display exponent "t" next to seed [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/seed.svg] in #FFCC00.
Show growth animation to height "8" in #FFFFFF.
Flash result "8" and seed [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/seed.svg] "2^3=8" to emphasize.

sections.title: Roots: Finding the Seed
lecture_lines: Now, let's reverse the growth process.
We look to find the seed.
This is the root operation.
The cube root of eight is two. [Asset: rewind_tree_animation]
animations: Display title "Finding the Seed" in #FFFFFF with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/seed.svg].
Show tree animation shrinking from 8 to 2 in #00FFFF.
Display radical notation 3rd-root(8)=2 in #FFCC00 to emphasize.

sections.title: Logarithms: Finding the Time
lecture_lines: Logarithms tell us the time passed.
We measure how long it grew.
Log base two of eight is three. [Asset: stopwatch_animation]
animations: Display title "Logarithms: Finding the Time" in #FFFFFF.
Fade out title, show stopwatch mobject [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stopwatch.svg] in #00FFFF.
Show formula log_2(8)=3 with stopwatch mobject in #FFCC00.

sections.title: Unified Notation: The Magic Triangle
lecture_lines: These are three parts of one story.
Powers, roots, and logarithms unite.
Base, exponent, result form a triangle.
We slide the dial to transform equations.
All expressions describe the same truth. [Asset: triangle_animation]
animations: Display title "Unified Notation: The Magic Triangle" in #FFFFFF.
Draw triangle with corner labels: 2^3=8, 3rd-root(8)=2, log_2(8)=3 in #FFCC00.
Animate sliding dial [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dial.svg] showing transformation equations.

sections.title: Application: The Astronaut's Fuel
lecture_lines: Rockets use this to track fuel.
We solve for time using logs.
Math fuels our journey through space. [Asset: rocket_fuel_animation]
